title: feedback group: digest/count/collect/rank aggregator, resolveInScope containment, per-call-site comparator fidelity
action: Port the feedback group: digest, count, collect, rank (handlers packages/bee/bee.mjs:4448-4513 (REVIEW-CORRECTED: handleFeedbackRank sits at 4504-4513, outside the old range); lib packages/bee/lib/feedback.mjs, 926 LOC). It is a pure aggregator over FOUR sources, not two — the plan named only half. REVIEW CORRECTION: .bee/backlog.jsonl and .bee/decisions.jsonl (the :106/:107 anchors are label CONSTANTS, not read sites — see the comment at :104-105), PLUS SRC_CELLS = .bee/cells (:108, read at :531-553 via listInScope) and SRC_LEARNINGS = docs/history/learnings (:109, read at :573). Port all four and give each its own scenario. It writes one output, .bee/feedback-digest.json (bee.mjs:4453), via writeJsonAtomic. This is why it lands last -- both source ledgers must already be byte-right (rpl-5, rpl-6). Preserve exactly: the READ-SCOPE INVARIANT (feedback.mjs:11-25) where every read routes through resolveInScope, which path.resolve + fs.realpathSync-es the target and enforces containment under .bee/ or docs/history/ -- port it with std::fs::canonicalize and the same allowed-prefix check, and keep the mjs-side comment's honesty that it is an accident-catcher, not a sandbox; the MIXED SORT COMPARATORS, bare .sort() at feedback.mjs:185,606,654 (JS default lexicographic on string coercion) versus .localeCompare at :648, :649, :819 ONLY — REVIEW CORRECTION: :976 is NOT a localeCompare site. packages/bee/lib/feedback.mjs:976-984 is a compound RAW code-unit comparator (rank desc, then first_seen asc, then key asc via bare < / >). Porting it as locale collation would be precisely the divergence class this cell exists to prevent -- replicate each call site's exact comparator, never unify them, and cover the divergence with a scenario whose keys separate the two orders; the datamark neutralization imported from decisions.mjs (feedback.mjs:30), consumed here from bee-core::datamark; readConfig from state.mjs (:31), consumed from bee-core::config. The plan open question is ALREADY ANSWERED by review and needs no rediscovery: the digest write lives in the HANDLER — packages/bee/bee.mjs:4475-4481, `writeJsonAtomic(outPath, digest)`, path constant at :4453. AND that write path DELIBERATELY BYPASSES the containment helper: `const outPath = path.resolve(root, outRel)` with no resolveInScope. Do not "fix" it — wrapping the write breaks parity on `--out ../x.json`. Register an --out escape-path scenario proving both runtimes write to the same out-of-tree location. SECOND CONTAINMENT CHECK, missed by the plan: besides resolveInScope (feedback.mjs:11-25), the collect/mergeDigests path carries a distinct realpath + regular-file check with its own refusal message at packages/bee/lib/feedback.mjs:739-766 ("D2b realpath containment"). Port BOTH and give EACH its own symlink-escape scenario. Also assert this group unknown-verb usage fallback line (packages/bee/bee.mjs:6586-6609). Register --cmd-check scenarios: digest over a host-real fixture; count and rank on empty sources; a symlink pointing outside .bee/ (both runtimes must refuse identically); keys chosen so lexicographic and locale order disagree; a corrupt-tail source ledger.

truths: cargo run --release --manifest-path crates/Cargo.toml -p bee-parity -- --cmd-check --group feedback reports every feedback scenario clean, .bee/feedback-digest.json byte-identical between runtimes
the symlink-escape scenario is refused identically by both runtimes
a key set where lexicographic and locale order disagree produces mjs-identical ordering at every call site
all FOUR sources are read and each has its own scenario: .bee/backlog.jsonl, .bee/decisions.jsonl, .bee/cells/, docs/history/learnings/
feedback.mjs:976 is ported as a compound RAW code-unit comparator (rank desc, first_seen asc, key asc) and NOT as locale collation
BOTH containment checks are ported and each has its own symlink-escape scenario refused identically to mjs: resolveInScope (feedback.mjs:11-25) and the D2b realpath containment (:739-766)
`digest --out ../x.json` writes to the same out-of-tree location in both runtimes — the write path is intentionally uncontained and must stay so
the feedback unknown-verb usage fallback line is byte-identical to mjs

the workspace test run at the head of this cell verify is green with --no-fail-fast, so no cross-cutting pin has rotted outside every cell own gate (the rpl-3 goal-check found one that had been false for two cells because it sat outside every verify and was never executed)
